govdocs-archive_org-nsia-MazzarellaJosep: This United Press International piece — Court Hears Suit Against LBJ Guard — is a wire story. The guard faced the court. The suit drew attention. The file belongs to the legal archive. The item is a fragment of press history.
the-boys-of-bellwood-school-or-frank-jor: Frank V. Webster's school story follows Frank Jordan through his terms at Bellwood School, where lessons, sports, and schoolboy rivalries test his character. Like all good school tales, it rewards honesty and pluck while punishing bullies and cheats. Young readers of the 1910s devoured such books, living their own school days a little more heroically through Frank.
the-boy-scout-camera-club-or-the-confess: Ralphson's Boy Scouts form a camera club, and a photograph's confession solves their mystery. Scouting, sleuthing, and early photography combine. A novel blend of hobbies for 1910s boys. Darkrooms, lenses, and scout law combine in this unusual series entry. A guilty secret, caught on film, drives this clever scout tale.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-aistulph: A 1913 entry on Aistulph — the Lombard king who marched on Rome. Ewan Macpherson tells his bold story. Pepin crossed the Alps to stop him. The papal states were born of the clash. A barbarian king in the pope's tale. His laws survive in the Lombard code.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-ancient-dioce: A 1913 entry on the ancient diocese of St. Asaph — the Welsh see. Edwin Burton gives its story. Its bishops served through conquest and reform. The cathedral stands in the green vale. Wales's northern bishopric. Its choir sings in the Welsh tongue.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-ange-de-saint: This 1913 reference piece on Ange de Saint-Joseph — the Carmelite orientalist. Thomas Walsh honors his Persian studies. His Gazophylacium unlocked the tongue. Rome prized his eastern lore. A friar among the linguists. His Persian grammar served the missionaries. His order sent him to Persia.
